newsitem.title: CHINA: China imposes curfew after riot in Xinjiang.
newsitem.headline: China imposes curfew after riot in Xinjiang.

text.p: Authorities have imposed a curfew in a mainly Moslem town near China's border with Kazakhstan after a separatist riot last week in which at least 10 people were killed, local residents said on Monday.
"A circular has been issued and broadcast on television ordering people not to go out after dark," one local resident said by telephone from the town of Yining in the northwestern Xinjiang region.
"We don't go out after the sun sets," said the resident, a Han Chinese living in the mainly Moslem town in the Yili Kazakh Autonomous Region. "There is a curfew every night."
At least 10 people were killed and many injured when about 1,000 Moslem separatists of the Uighur ethnic minority clashed with police last Wednesday during a riot against Chinese rule.
"We don't dare to go out," said another Han Chinese resident.
